intros t t1 t2 t3 a a1 l Hun Hdll.
revert Hun.
induction Hdll as [Mnil Mptr prev | Malloc Mptr prev h s Hne Hprev Hmem Hval Hsub IH]; intro Hun.
- apply Q_P_dll_dll_nil.
- apply Q_P_dll_dll_cons with (Mptr := t2).
  + exact Hne.
  + pose proof (length_pos s) as Hpos.
    assert (H0 : (0 <= 0)%Z) by lia.
    assert (Hlt : (0 < list.Length.length (h :: s))%Z) by (rewrite length_cons; lia).
    destruct (Hun 0%Z H0 Hlt) as [Hpair Hval0].
    rewrite nth_zero in Hpair.
    destruct Hpair as [H1 H2].
    rewrite H2. exact Hprev.
  + exact Hmem.
  + pose proof (length_pos s) as Hpos.
    assert (H0 : (0 <= 0)%Z) by lia.
    assert (Hlt : (0 < list.Length.length (h :: s))%Z) by (rewrite length_cons; lia).
    destruct (Hun 0%Z H0 Hlt) as [Hpair Hval0].
    rewrite nth_zero in Hval0.
    exact Hval0.
  + pose proof (length_pos s) as Hpos.
    assert (H0 : (0 <= 0)%Z) by lia.
    assert (Hlt : (0 < list.Length.length (h :: s))%Z) by (rewrite length_cons; lia).
    destruct (Hun 0%Z H0 Hlt) as [Hpair Hval0].
    rewrite nth_zero in Hpair.
    destruct Hpair as [H1 H2].
    rewrite H1.
    apply IH.
    assert (Htail : forall i : Numbers.BinNums.Z,
      (0%Z <= i)%Z -> (i < list.Length.length s)%Z ->
      ((t2 (shift (nth s i) 1%Z) = Mptr (shift (nth s i) 1%Z)) /\
       (t2 (shift (nth s i) 2%Z) = Mptr (shift (nth s i) 2%Z))) /\
      valid_rw t (nth s i) 3%Z).
    { intros i Hi0 Hlen.
      assert (Hi0' : (0 <= 1 + i)%Z) by lia.
      assert (Hlt' : (1 + i < list.Length.length (h :: s))%Z) by (rewrite length_cons; lia).
      destruct (Hun (1 + i)%Z Hi0' Hlt') as [Hpair Hvali].
      assert (Hk : ((1 + i)%Z = 0%Z -> nth (h :: s) (1 + i)%Z = h) /\
                   (~ (1 + i)%Z = 0%Z -> nth (h :: s) (1 + i)%Z = nth s ((1 + i - 1)%Z))).
      { apply (nth_cons (1 + i)%Z h s). split. lia. lia. }
      destruct Hk as [_ Hkpos].
      assert (Hnz : ~ ((1 + i)%Z = 0%Z)) by lia.
      assert (Heq : (1 + i - 1)%Z = i) by lia.
      rewrite (Hkpos Hnz) in Hpair.
      rewrite (Hkpos Hnz) in Hvali.
      rewrite Heq in Hpair.
      rewrite Heq in Hvali.
      exact (conj Hpair Hvali). }
    exact Htail.
